title: Sandbox Host: Session lifecycle, tier routing, tool dispatch, snapshots
description:
Implement SandboxHostService from docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (SandboxHostService struct + ServiceConfig), §4 (session lifecycle), §5 (tool dispatch + tier routing), §6 (snapshot management), §7 (cmd/sandbox-host binary)

Key deliverables:
- SandboxHostService struct with NewSandboxHostService(cfg, ZFSManager, GVisorManager, logger)
- Session management: CreateSession (mutex for TOCTOU), DestroySession, PauseSession, ResumeSession
- Session state machine: Creating → Active → Paused → Active → Destroying → [destroyed], plus Failed
- Tool dispatch: ExecuteTool with tier classification — Tier 1 (local, fast) vs Tier 2 (gVisor container)
- Tier routing: ClassifyTool determines execution path, Tier 2 creates container with ZFS bind-mount
- Per-turn snapshots: TurnComplete using prospectiveTurn pattern
- Per-tool snapshots: opt-in via config.PerToolSnapshots, named tool-{toolCallID}-{timestamp}
- Snapshot management: CreateSnapshot, RollbackSession, ListSnapshots
- cmd/sandbox-host binary skeleton with graceful shutdown
- Unit tests for session lifecycle, state machine transitions, tier routing, snapshot management

See Implementation Guide §1.10: CreateSession uses mutex for atomic capacity-check + store (P1 finding). TurnComplete uses prospectiveTurn pattern. ZFS rollback is synchronous (<100ms), no RollingBack state.
See Implementation Guide §1.6: ToolBackend contract — SandboxBackend must accept and propagate onProgress. SnapshotID propagation chain.

Depends on: ZFS Manager (aiag-8o6) and gVisor Manager (aiag-xmq) epics — both must complete before this task starts.
